kāyati.p: [Ke+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 [Ku saddeke ca. Nīti, dhā. 10.] (1) Talks or chants. (2) Makes to know.

P: Kayati，[krī，perhaps connected with kṛ] to buy； Inf．ketuṁ J．III，282； cp．kiṇāti．（Page 195）
R:
kayati：ကယတိ （√ကီ）
ဝယ်၏။

kāyati：ကာယတိ （√ကေ）
အသံပြု၏။
B:
kāyati： kāyati（kri）
ကာယတိ（ကြိ）
[ke+a+ti．ku saddeke ca．nīti，dhā．1va．]
[ကေ+အ+တိ။ ကု သဒေ္ဒကေ စ။ နီတိ၊ ဓာ။ ၁ဝ။]
K:
kāyati：ကာယတိ （ကြိ）
[ကေ+အ+တိ။ ကု သဒေ္ဒကေ စ။ နီတိ၊ ဓာ။ ၁ဝ။]
（၁） ဆို၏။ （၂） သိစေတတ်၏။
DOP: kāyati pr. 3 sg. [ S. Dhātup kāyati, Wg § 22:19 ], makes a sound; tells ; Dhātup 392 (kā gā sadde) = Dhātum 626; Dhātum 9 (ke sadde); Sadd 321, 8 (ku sadde ke ca: … ~ati); 476, 4 foll. (ke re ge sadde:~ati … jātaṃ … ~ati katheti bhagavā etenā ti jātakaṃ); Pj II 204, 8 (vibhūtiṃ ~ati karoti vā vibhūtikaṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se kāsati); — pass. 3 sg. kīyati , Sadd 321, 21 (taṃ ~ati kathīyati etenā ti jātakaṃ).
CPD: kāyati, pr. 3. sg., to recite, to chant (only in etymol. ex­pli­ca­tions); — gr. lit.: kā gā sadde, Dhātup 392 foll. = Dhā­tum 626 foll.; ku sadde ke ca … ~ati, Sadd 321, 8 ; pass. kīyati kathīyati, Sadd 321, 21 ; — Sāmavedo taṃ sar­ena ~antîti Chandokā Sāma­vedino, Chandogîti pi paṭhan­ti, Sv-pṭ l 520, 13 ; Vede padaso ~atîti padako, Sv-pṭ l 380, 4 ( Ee kāsati, but ~atîti katheti yathā jātakan ti, Sv-nṭ ll 224, 20 ) = Ps-pṭ lll 167, 3 , cf. ~atîti … paññāyati, Sadd 327, 21 ( so Be; Ee khāyati); vibhūtiṃ ~ati, Pj ll 204, 8 ; cf. kāyituṃ, kāyana, q.v.
